}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== *"Model Number: HDM11L1", "PCB P/N:08-04HDM1112" and :"VER:V1.2" are silkscreened on the board. *This is a 1-bay NAS. It would appear to have 2x USB 2.0 ports. {{See also|Synology DiskStation Devices|List of NAS Devices}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F3720 @800MHz :Dual-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Memory: 512MB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :1x SATA 3.0 port *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 2x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 3A via barrel
